gold.user: As a developer, I want to retrieve a list of all available .gitignore templates so that I can choose the appropriate one for my project.
gold.ideal: The response should include a JSON array of template names and their descriptions, allowing me to easily identify which template fits my needs.

gold.user: As a developer, I want to fetch a specific .gitignore template by its name so that I can quickly copy its content into my project.
gold.ideal: The response should return the content of the specified .gitignore template in plain text format, enabling me to use it directly.
